description: This file is the entry point for the React frontend of the Tic Tac Toe application. It imports necessary libraries, styles, and main App component, then renders the App into the DOM.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root React node for rendering, attaching to the DOM element with id 'root'.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React application into the DOM within the root created.
